description: A shell script designed to compare the results of different ptest runs by analyzing ptest log files or summaries. It provides options for detailed failure reports and verbose output, and defines functions for parsing log details, summarizing results, and generating a diff report.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: debug_echo
methods.description: Prints debug messages if DEBUG is set to 1.

methods.name: get_ptest_list
methods.description: Extracts the list of ptest runs from the input log file.

methods.name: get_ptest_pkg_result
methods.description: Determines the pass/fail/skip status of a specific ptest package from a log file.

methods.name: get_ptest_pkg_failures
methods.description: Retrieves detailed failure information for a specific ptest package.

methods.name: get_testcases_summary
methods.description: Summarizes overall pass/fail/skip counts for test cases from logs.

methods.name: print_package
methods.description: Outputs a list of package ptest paths with indentation.

methods.name: print_package_failures
methods.description: Outputs failures for a list of packages.

methods.name: report_diff
methods.description: Main function to compare two log files, analyze differences in ptest outcomes, and generate a detailed report including statistics and optional verbose output.
